resources.string: Set up reading
Your manga, in English
Yomu finds the speech bubbles, reads the Japanese and translates it on your device. Your pages stay with you.
Read in the apps you love
Turn reading on and leave it on while you browse. Tap Yomu’s floating button whenever you want to translate a page.
First, download the models that read and translate the page. The defaults suit most devices; tap a model to pick another.
Detection
Finds the speech bubbles on the page.
OCR
Reads the text inside each bubble. Pick the model for the language your comic is written in.
Translation
The on-device model that translates each bubble.
